content:
Latest macOS 26.7 beta appears to have leaked extensive information about several upcoming Apple home products. Among them are mentions of a next-generation HomePod mini, a security camera, a new Siri Remote designed for the upcoming Apple TV 4K, and the much-anticipated HomePad device.

Further in-depth examination of this code also seems to provide a number of important clues about the HomePad's design...

Filipe Espósito of Engadget discovered that while the HomePad is likely to run a variant of tvOS, its operation may more closely resemble that of a 'larger Apple Watch'.

The code also revealed a welcome privacy feature: widgets will only display your personal information when your iPhone is detected to be nearby.

We expect the HomePad to come in two versions — one with a speaker base (which may look similar to a HomePod), and another designed for wall mounting.

In addition to the other Apple home products I mentioned above, the code also references several unannounced devices. Personally, I'm really hoping a smart doorbell is among them. Are there any Apple home products you're particularly looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
